new-game.title: New game

new-game.custom-map-description: Choose the parameters supported by the current generator. Planned settings remain visible so this window can grow without changing its structure.
new-game.profile-name-tooltip: The name stored with this save series. It can be changed before starting the map.
new-game.invalid-profile-name: Enter a profile name containing from 1 to 64 visible characters.
new-game.seed-tooltip: A hexadecimal value up to 16 digits. The same seed and map size reproduce the same generated map.

new-game.river-tooltip: Choose no directed river, the original single channel, or a second channel joining it. Natural pools and local water access remain in every mode.
new-game.road-tooltip: Generate no road, one road joining opposite map edges, or a through-road with a branch to another edge. Roads use shallow fords where they cross water.
new-game.planned-tooltip: Planned — the current generator and save profile do not support changing this parameter yet.

hud.help:
LMB: select and use tools • Build/Terrain/Work: action menus • Σ: reports • drag RMB: camera • WASD/arrows: camera • wheel: zoom • F3: 2D/3D renderer • F4: top-down/angled • Q/E: rotate 3D • ~: pause • 1–4: speed • Alt+Enter: fullscreen
Work areas and bridges: drag LMB • explored terrain can be marked even when currently out of sight • Esc: cancel tool

windows.stored-summary: Physical contents of all tribal storage.
windows.details-tooltip: Separates food, wood species, and stone types.
windows.loose-summary: Known goods lying on the ground. They are not included in stored supplies.

build-prompts.food-storage: Build food storage: click once or drag a rectangle for several adjacent stores • cost 2 wood each • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wood-storage: Build wood storage: click once or drag a rectangle for several adjacent stores • cost 2 wood each • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.stone-storage: Build stone storage: click once or drag a rectangle for several adjacent stores • cost 2 wood each • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.equipment-storage: Build equipment storage: click once or drag a rectangle for several adjacent stores • cost 2 wood each • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.materials-storage: Build materials storage: click once or drag a rectangle for several adjacent stores • cost 2 wood each • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.water-barrel: Place water barrels: click once or drag a rectangle • finished barrels will be brought from a workshop or storage • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-box: Place boxes: click once or drag a rectangle • each holds 4 types with 8 units • finished boxes will be delivered • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-chest: Place chests: click once or drag a rectangle • each holds 8 types with 8 units • finished chests will be delivered • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.bulk-bin: Place bulk bins: click once or drag a rectangle • each holds one type with up to 64 units • finished bins will be delivered • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.storage-area: Designate a storage area: drag a rectangle of up to 256 explored cells • the area itself provides no capacity • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.walkway: Build a bridge: {0} • drag LMB from start to end • 1 wood/segment • wood cannot cover lava • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.basalt-walkway: Build a stone bridge: {0} • drag LMB from start to end • 1 stone/segment • lava-proof • requires tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.field-camp: 2×2 field camp: select the upper-left corner • cost 6 wood • includes provision storage • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.goblin-hut: 3×3 hut: select the upper-left corner • cost 8 wood • provides {0} places and raises the population target • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.goblin-compost: Build a tribal compost hollow: select an explored open cell • cost 2 reeds • receives recovered bodies for corpse-origin budding • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-watchtower: Build a 2×2 wooden watchtower: select the upper-left corner • cost 8 wood • 2 guard posts with doubled sight and ranged reach • built-in ladder, 2 beds and a small food store • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.reed-sleeping-mat: Build a reed sleeping mat: select a free accessible cell • cost 2 reeds • covered mats are preferred • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-wall: Build a wooden wall: {0} • drag LMB from start to end • 2 wood/segment • blocks movement • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.stone-wall: Build a stone wall: {0} • drag LMB from start to end • 2 units of stone/segment • requires tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-floor: Build a wooden floor or ceiling from: {0} • can cover open space • drag a rectangle of up to 256 cells • 1 wood/cell • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.stone-floor: Build a stone floor or ceiling from: {0} • can cover open space • drag a rectangle of up to 256 cells • 1 stone/cell • requires tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-ramp: Build a wooden ramp from: {0} • drag exactly one cell: from lower ground toward the upper level, or from upper ground toward empty space below • cost 2 wood • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.stone-ramp: Build a stone ramp from: {0} • drag exactly one cell: from lower ground toward the upper level, or from upper ground toward empty space below • cost 3 stone • requires tool level 2 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-ladder: Build a wooden ladder: drag one cell between lower ground and an adjacent upper platform • occupies only the lower cell • cost 1 wood • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-door-frame: Build a wooden door frame from {0}: select a cell with LMB • cost 1 wood • can replace a completed wall • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.stone-door-frame: Build a stone door frame from {0}: select a cell with LMB • cost 1 stone • requires tool level 1 • can replace a completed stone wall • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wooden-door: Build a wooden door from {0}: select a completed frame with LMB • cost 1 wood • click the door after construction to open it • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.wall-torch: Build a torch: drag from an explored wall toward the desired mounting side • cost 1 wood • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.standing-torch: Build a standing torch basket: select an explored free cell • cost 1 wood • casts light in every direction • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.primitive-workshop: Build a primitive workshop: select a cell with LMB • cost 4 wood • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.cooking-fire: Build a cooking fire: select a free cell • cost 3 wood • burns 1 wood to cook 2 portions of raw meat • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.bloomery: Build a bloomery: select a cell with LMB • cost 12 stones with strength and durability of at least 35 • requires building 1 and tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.smelting-furnace: Build a smelting furnace: select a cell with LMB • cost 16 stones with strength and durability of at least 45 • requires building 2 and tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels
build-prompts.crucible-furnace: Build a crucible furnace: select a cell with LMB • cost 20 stones with strength of at least 60 and durability 65 • requires building 2 and tool level 1 • RMB or Esc cancels

work-prompts.gather-reeds: Work: drag a reed-gathering area • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.gather-lichen: Work: drag over explored cave lichen • each patch can be gathered once • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.gather-brushwood: Work: drag a brushwood-gathering area • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.gather-stone: Work: drag a small-stone gathering area • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.uproot-bushes: Work: drag a bush-clearing area • removes bushes permanently • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.fell-trees: Work: drag a logging area • individual trees and dead trunks will remain as targets • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.quarry-boulders: Work: drag a quarrying area • individual boulders will remain as targets • requires tool level 2 • RMB or Esc cancels

work-prompts.carve-ramp-down: Work: click an explored floor to carve enclosed stairs one level down • requires tool level 2 • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.carve-ramp-up: Work: click an explored cave floor to carve enclosed stairs one level up • requires tool level 2 • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.hunt-animals: Hunting: drag an area • individual animals will remain as targets • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.hunt-area: Area hunting: point at the center of a circle • mouse wheel changes its radius • LMB designates visible animals • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.scout: Scouting: drag an allowed area • scouts may cross known terrain but will not enter unknown terrain outside the selection • RMB or Esc cancels
work-prompts.clean-blood: Work: drag an area to clean blood and tracked dirt from accessible surfaces • RMB or Esc cancels

options.title: Options
options.language-restart: The language selection is saved immediately and takes effect after restarting the game.
options.performance-help: Only dirty lower-level terrain chunks are rebuilt. The minimum interval is multiplied by depth; larger chunks use more cache memory and rebuild a wider area after a local change.
options.warm-caches: Prepare rendering cache before showing the game
options.warm-caches-help: Wait during loading until the initial world view, visible lower-level chunks, and minimap are ready. Disable this to enter sooner and let the cache warm in the background.
options.onion-layers-help: Use the lowest-load cross-section on upper levels (Z > 0). Rendering does not draw or monitor lower levels; openings use a static dark-gray hatched plane instead.
options.underground-onion-layers-help: Use the same static cross-section on the surface and underground (Z ≤ 0). Leave this off to retain detailed cached views through smaller openings.
options.shortcuts-help: Select a shortcut and press a new key. Indented actions work after opening their parent menu.
